steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Physical skills are the foundation of all dance performance and underpin technical and expressive work | Key Fact: Flexibility is the range of movement at a joint and allows dancers to achieve extended lines and shapes | Key Fact: Strength is the ability of muscles to exert force and is needed for lifts, jumps and controlled movements | Key Fact: Stamina (cardiovascular endurance) enables dancers to sustain energy throughout an entire performance

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from physical skills in dance, and one past-paper question.
